plate.webp.title: Agaricus xerampelinus (tab. 31), Coloured Figures of English Fungi or Mushrooms
plate.webp.maker: James Sowerby (drawn, etched and published); coloured by hand
plate.webp.holder: New York Botanical Garden, LuEsther T. Mertz Library; digitised by the Internet Archive
plate.webp.changes: Rotated upright, cropped between gutter and fore-edge (2000x3665), page colour composited beyond the leaf's top and bottom edges. The pencil note under the plate is a later owner's.

plate-paper.webp, plate-print.webp, plat.changes: Decomposition in optical density into bare leaf, printed impression, flat washes; arrival-time and mask maps. Ours.
